Evidence: 2014 me, Republicans ne Congress ke elections me significant gains kiye, jisme unhone 16 seats Democratic se jeeti aur total 247 seats par control hasil kiya, jo 1928 ke baad unka sabse bada majority hai (Source 3). Is election ke natije me, Democratic Party ne 77 seats khoyi, jo Barack Obama ke presidency ke dauran sabse zyada hai (Source 3). Mehngai par control ka koi specific reference nahi hai, lekin elections ke natije se pata chalta hai ki logon ka dissatisfaction tha (Source 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki 2014 ke elections me Republicans ne Congress me control hasil kiya, jo mehngai par control nahi karne ka ek natija ho sakta hai. Lekin, evidence me mehngai par control na karne ka koi direct sambandh nahi hai, isliye claim ko support nahi milta. Isliye, yeh claim refute hota hai.
